admission_evidence.completeness_rule: All OpenDataSoft records match total_count; duplicate development_keys fail

description: Monitors major new commercial and residential property development in the City of Melbourne municipality. Tracks development sites across 13 small areas that are mooted/applied, approved, under construction, or completed. Source status must be preserved without collapsing into approved.

invariants.status_preservation_rule: Development status must retain distinct source states: 'mooted' (from APPLIED/MOOTED/PLANNED), 'approved', 'under_construction', and 'completed'. Never collapse or merge into a single 'approved' status.
invariants.point_coordinate_rule: Preserves WGS84 point coordinates (longitude, latitude) as GeoJSON Point and centroid (lon, lat); coordinates must never be inverted and missing coordinates must remain null, never 0,0.
invariants.monthly_update_rule: Upstream dataset follows a monthly update cycle; connector records source publication and modified timestamps.
